subject: PromptNest + Redwood: pre-instrumentation pilot and co-marketing
messages:
From: Alex Moore <alex@promptnest.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Taylor Reed <taylor@promptnest.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: PromptNest + Redwood: pre-instrumentation pilot and co-marketing

Hi Sean,

Hope you're well — quick intro: I run platform partnerships at PromptNest (we build prompt orchestration and developer tooling used by ~120 ISVs). We've been evaluating Redwood's runtime and developer-facing observability — really impressed by the routing/fallbacks and the unit-cost tooling.

We'd like to propose a small pilot to instrument our JS/Go SDK so that:
- Redwood can receive consistent prompt/trace metadata (trace_id, prompt_template_id, execution flags) from PromptNest clients;
- We validate token attribution across your distributed serving (prefix caching + batching);
- Collect a shared set of telemetry (latency p95, tokens per request, model variant fallback counts) for 6 weeks.

Attached is a first-pass SDK mapping (PromptNest_SDK_Mapping.xlsx) and a short SOW draft (PN_SOW_v1.pdf). We're flexible on scope but are hoping for a minimal path-to-value: developer hooks + a tracing shim that surfaces prompt attribution to Redwood traces.

Two asks to start:
1) Can we get a short internal checklist from your side (security guardrails, expected timeline, Redwood contacts for engineering/legal)?
2) Would Redwood be interested in a joint blog + webinar at pilot close (we can co-sponsor lead outreach)?

If you think this is worth a quick call, Taylor and I are available Tue/Wed next week.

Best,
Alex Moore
Head of Platform Partnerships
PromptNest

Attachments: PromptNest_SDK_Mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet), PN_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex@promptnest.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PromptNest + Redwood: pre-instrumentation pilot and co-marketing

Alex — thanks for the intro and the materials, appreciate the specificity. Short reply with proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Internal checklist (high level) — what we need from PromptNest before code drops:
   - completed security questionnaire (SOC2 attestation + minimal network model)
   - sample SDK bundle and mapping (you've included mapping which is great)
   - SSO/CI credentials for test accounts (dev sandbox)

2) Pilot scope suggestion (minimal):
   - Instrumentation shim in PromptNest SDK to emit prompt metadata to Redwood tracing API (trace_id + prompt_template_id + partial prompt hash)
   - Telemetry dashboard for token attribution by client and model variant
   - Weekly telemetry report + final co-authored recap

3) Timeline idea: kickoff Wed May 12 -> config + dev week 1 -> sandbox validation week 2 -> pilot run 4 weeks -> wrap + co-marketing. Total ~6 weeks.

Vanessa, Priyom — looping you in for engineering ownership and telemetry SLOs. Alex/Taylor, can you confirm Tue/Wed availability for a 30m kickoff? If Wed works, we'd like to surface a short SOW and a DocuSign link so legal can move in parallel.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Director, ISV Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 18:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PromptNest + Redwood: pre-instrumentation pilot and co-marketing

Thanks Sean / Alex (looping back with internal notes). I can lead the integration work on Redwood's side — quick operational items and proposed measurement plan: 

Operational items (we'll own):
- Provide Redwood instrument template (RWI_instrument_template.xlsx) with required headers and sample trace payloads
- Stand up a sandbox ingestion endpoint for PromptNest SDK test traffic
- Add a short runbook for model-variant fallback labeling so attribution is deterministic

What we want from PromptNest (deliverables):
- SDK change that emits: trace_id, prompt_template_id, client_id, token_count_estimate, and a 10-token prefix hash for privacy
- Sample traffic (10k requests) against sandbox within first validation window
- Security questionnaire + contact for privacy/infosec (we'll run a light review)

Measurement plan (shared KPIs):
- Telemetry fidelity: >99% trace linkage for instrumented calls
- Token attribution accuracy: <5% delta vs PromptNest internal accounting
- Latency delta (client SDK -> Redwood runtime): p95 < 200ms added overhead

Procurement/legal note: if PromptNest prefers a standard pilot SOW, our legal ops can review DocuSign within 3 business days after receipt. Recommend including a short data handling appendix (we'll supply language).

If others agree, I'll draft the integration checklist and a 6-week calendar (kickoff -> validation -> pilot -> wrap). Wed May 12 at 10am PT works for me.

—Vanessa
VP, Partner Engineering
Redwood Inference
